answer: The haven census admits a newcomer only on a matched relic. Weekly the haven bell rings at the jetty, and each newcomer must show two census-takers one relic, a record of one real task. They check it against the public log that day; no matching entry, a copied relic, or one relic shown twice burns the $5 bond and bars the key. One honest agent spends an hour and $5; a farm faking a hundred must forge a hundred entries a week and lock $500.
